text:
Maya (Design): tiny dashboard nit  microchart gridlines feel too heavy at 1px when tiles are small. can we try a hairline variant (0.5px) for tiles? :eyes:
Ish (Frontend): 0.5px is doable but canvas/SVG render differs. best to draw on canvas with translate(0.5,0.5) trick or use slightly higher alpha for visibility.
a11y-bot: accessibility note: sub-pixel strokes can fail contrast on some displays. ensure grid color contrast >= 3:1 vs background. if using 0.5px, increase alpha rather than reduce color luminance.
Priya (Data): unit snapping request: for compact tiles snap ticks to human steps (1,2,5 * 10^n) and drop decimals (show 1K not 1.0K). full charts keep exacts.
Sam (Product): copy tweak: change units toggle to "Units: Smart | Full" (Smart = humanized). previous labels were confusing in support.
Maya (Design): smoothing: ops reported spline causes small artificial dips. default should be linear/no smoothing; offer "Soft" as opt-in with a tiny pill "soften" and tooltip "may alter peak values".
Ish (Frontend): outlier handling: two asks (clamp vs show all). plan: clamp by default at 3x IQR for dashboards, add legend kebab action "Show full range (includes outliers)" that re-renders with true bounds. aria-label for action: "Show full chart range, including outliers".
Sam (Product): rollout: dashboards first behind flag; embeds/legacy unchanged for one release. run a 2-week AB test measuring perceived readability + support tickets about "missing spikes".
Maya (Design): will add side-by-side mocks (grid 0.5 vs 1px, Smart vs Full units, clamp vs full scale) and annotate contrast and smoothing notes. mark ready for design-qa when uploaded. :white_check_mark:
